newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine March industrial output seen up 7.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine March industrial output seen up 7.2 pct.

text.p: Argentina's industrial production in March is expected to rise 7.2 percent, according to the average estimate by 10 analysts in a Reuters poll.
The Economy Ministry and the FIEL private consultancy are due to release March industrial production figures Wednesday.
In February industrial production rose 6.9 percent from the same month a year earlier.
The estimates for the March figure ranged from a high of 10 percent to a low of 4.6 percent.
